title: Setup metadata editor: views, apps and dashboards are still edited from the translated served read, so a non-English save stores the translation as source text
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVfPeFZkN1FP93imKU

Filing gate: ① product defect, named location. This is an out-of-scope finding of #29793 (os-dev-report 6675573325, `out_of_scope_findings` 1 and 2), owed by landed work: PR #30784 fixes the object type only. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
class: a · reach: named producer, Setup's metadata editor, which is mounted at `/apps/setup/metadata/<type>/<name>` (it lands on `/studio/~all/metadata/...`). `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` seeds the edit buffer as `draftReal ?? baseline` for every type except `object`, at load, the save refresh and the publish refresh. `draftReal` is the `?state=draft` read, `baseline` is `effective ?? code`, and reset and discard use `effective ?? code`. #29793 measured that read for objects in a zh-CN console on `origin/main` `e8dc4833`: translated for `Accept-Language` and governed. NOT MEASURED for view / app / dashboard: the first step measures one of them live.

## Business reason

A tenant who edits a list view, an app or a dashboard in Setup with the console in Chinese (or any non-English locale) saves the translated labels as if the author typed them. English readers then get Chinese, and the author's own zh view keeps showing the catalog string, so the edit looks reverted. #29793 showed exactly this for objects, and the server answers it with `translated-label-echo` advisories on save.

## Wanted

1. Measure first, in a zh-CN console on `main`: for one view, one app and one dashboard with a published zh-CN translation, open in Setup's editor, edit one label, save, and record the PUT body. Say per type whether it carries translations, and whether the layered read serves `draft` / `overlay` / `code` for that type.
2. For each type that reproduces, the buffer is the author-owned document, `draft ?? overlay ?? code` (spec `GetMetaItemLayeredResponseSchema.draft`), through the one reading PR #30784 added (`authoredObjectBuffer.ts`, generalised rather than copied). Display may stay on `effective`. Flow (a published name), a code-defined datasource and an orphan row are the cases where `overlay ?? code` is not the server's reading: the first step names how each is handled, or excludes it.
3. Same class, second producer: plugin-designer's `MetadataObjectsPage` (`client.list`) and `MetadataFieldsPage` (`client.get`) seed their edit base from the served object and save it live. They have no mount in this repo but are exported from `@object-ui/plugin-designer`. Their edit base becomes `layered('object', name)` `overlay ?? code`, or the card says why not.
4. Pin each fixed type with a zh-CN test: the PUT body carries source labels, plus an ablation.

**Level:** client behaviour only, expected `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Reader: `domain:ui` (`ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `authoredObjectBuffer.ts`, plugin-designer).
Dedupe: `ResourceEditPage translated served draft` (is:issue is:open) → 1 hit, #29793 (this card's parent, object only); `plugin-designer MetadataObjectsPage served` → #29793 only; `edit buffer translated label echo view` → #29793 only.

Related: #29793, PR #30784, #29814 (the `/layers` `draft` layer), #29673.
